profile.name: release-enabled-isolated-100rps-v1
profile.coldDefinition: Fresh owned fixture, seeded and ANALYZEd, all clients closed, owned PostgreSQL restarted before a fresh measurement process. PostgreSQL shared buffers reset; host filesystem caches are not flushed.
profile.reporting: 100% offered heartbeats and reports; errors, overload rejections, aborted requests and late offers fail acceptance

resources.processModel: Separate local Windows API, worker and generator Node processes; production CPU equivalence is not claimed.

interpretation: Diagnostic only: the full 6000-offer ingestion workload failed. Profiling overhead and the lack of concurrent reports/workers/lifecycle prevent capacity or deployment acceptance.

4382 heartbeats succeeded, 162 failed, 1456 were refused at the in-flight bound and none were offered late. 4493 observations persisted; accepted client responses and database writes are distinct counts.

The API consumed 84.657 CPU seconds, with event-loop utilization 0.9926419, 183 connection-acquisition failures and 21 cumulative optional telemetry failures. SQL maximum was about 272ms; pool acquisition peaked at 5.041s and 1005 waiters.

Independent sample reconstruction matches 45015 samples covering exactly 70.041139s between reset and snapshot. These are statistical wall-time samples, not exact function CPU measurements; inclusive stacks overlap.

Exclusive attribution includes Drizzle ORM 18.123s (25.9% of sampled wall time), native writev 6.160s (8.8%), pg-family code 6.477s and garbage collection 3.069s. The largest writev stack, 5.349s, is the PostgreSQL query socket-write path. This supports investigating repeated query construction and protocol work; it does not establish the benefit or safety of a specific optimization.

The phase snapshot still contained 3 active heartbeat_final_delivery leases. Clean process shutdown and later owned-process absence are verified; the snapshot must not be described as fully quiescent or used as evidence of a leaked lease.

Raw sourceClean and sourceUnchangedAtFinish are false and preserved. The run started with the previous failed-load evidence directory untracked. Later read-only verification found application/script/test/package files matching HEAD and all 11 recorded harness hashes matching. Root evidence README edits after the run explain the subsequent whole-tree check difference; this does not retroactively mark the diagnostic clean.

Independent analysis attempt 01 used an overly broad /dist/ application filter that also included dependency dist files. It is retained as superseded; independent-cpu-analysis.json and independent-analysis.mjs use the corrected /SchoolPilot/dist/ filter. No raw profile or original run file was changed.
